name: Australian BSB Identification
definition: Australian Bank State Branch (BSB) Code - identifies Australian financial institutions on the Australian national clearing system. The code is assigned by the Australian Payments Clearing Association (APCA).

ExtensiveBranchNetworkIdentification.name: Extensive Branch Network Identification
ExtensiveBranchNetworkIdentification.definition: Extensive branch network list of the Australian Bank State Branch (BSB) Code. The codes are used for identifying Australian financial institutions, as assigned by the Australian Payments Clearing Association (APCA).

SmallNetworkIdentification.name: Small Network Identification
SmallNetworkIdentification.definition: Small network list of the Australian Bank State Branch (BSB) Code. The codes are used for identifying Australian financial institutions , as assigned by the Australian Payments Clearing Association (APCA).

ClearingSystemMember.name: Clearing System Member
ClearingSystemMember.definition: Clearing system for which an Australian code is provided.

ClearingSystemMemberIdentificationType.name: Clearing System Member Identification Type
ClearingSystemMemberIdentificationType.definition: Clearing system member identification for which an Australian BSB identification is provided.
